text.title: Outer Rampart
text.body: The three-hundred-foot black basalt wall of the Infernal Citadel looms against a blood-red sky. While Marshal Vance and Harbor Marshal Veyra lead the coastal veterans in a fierce diversion, breach at least two of the three fortified gatehouses to crack the Inner Bailey.
text.obj.0: Breach at least two outer rampart gatehouses
text.obj.1: Defeat the Inner Bailey veteran garrison
text.msg.1: My Harborwatch veterans didn't stay off the ships to die at the moat! Vance and I will pin their battlements—breach two gatehouses and tear the Inner Bailey wide open!
text.msg.2: The West Postern gatehouse shatters under our rams!
text.msg.3: The Main Gatehouse is breached—violet ley-light bleeds through the basalt!
text.msg.4: The East Postern gatehouse collapses into rubble!
text.msg.5: The Outer Rampart breaks! The Citadel's veteran inner garrison pours into the bailey—hold nothing back!
text.win: The Outer Rampart lies shattered and the doorway into the heart of the mountain stands open.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell beneath the Outer Rampart.
